HealingPotion._comment: The Healing Potion research costs 300 copper (was 570) and takes half as long (45 points, was 90). UnlockCost is gold/silver/copper as X/Y/Z; only Z is given, so X and Y stay 0.

FactorySpeed1._comment: What Factory Efficiency 1 does: +50 % production speed (was +25 %), with FactoryConsumeSpeed still +25 % (in game, heat use rose with the speed anyway). Effects is a list, so both entries are given.
